name: Maur Raincaller
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Maur Raincaller watches over Mulgore’s herds and wild beasts. He attends to concerns tied to the plains’ natural and spiritual life.

sections.title: A Resident of Bloodhoof Village
sections.body: Maur Raincaller lives near the heart of Bloodhoof Village, on the shore of Lake Stonebull. He watches over matters involving Mulgore’s wildlife and the balance of the elements. After the strider Mazzranache bites him and infects his wound, Maur asks young travelers to gather animal parts for a remedy.

faq.answer: Maur Raincaller is a tauren who lives in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He asks travelers to deal with unruly wildlife nearby.

faq.q: Where can I find Maur Raincaller?
faq.answer: Maur Raincaller can be found outdoors in Bloodhoof Village, among its tepees and hearth fires. The village lies south of Thunder Bluff, on the eastern bank of Lake Stonebull.

faq.q: What trouble is Maur dealing with?
faq.answer: Maur Raincaller’s wound is infected after Mazzranache bites him. He asks travelers to bring parts from Mulgore’s wolves, cougars, plainstriders and swoops so he can make a remedy.

angles.text: As a young tauren leaving Camp Narache, you can help protect your people’s ancestral lands from wandering predators and disruptive beasts.
Maur Raincaller sends you to hunt wolves, cougars, plainstriders and swoops across the plains for parts to treat the bite Mazzranache gave him.
